aboutPage.lead: Perfect Parfums — A space for niche and elite perfumery in decant format for true aesthetes
aboutPage.intro: Welcome to Perfect Parfums — an online store that opens the world of high perfumery art for you! We believe a fragrance is much more than a finishing touch to your look. It is an invisible calling card, an emotion in the moment, and a refined way to express your individuality. That is why we carefully select every composition so you can collect new olfactory impressions and refresh your fragrance wardrobe for any mood.
aboutPage.offerIntro: Perfect Parfums is a rich, refined collection of original fragrances in a convenient decant format that will satisfy the most discerning connoisseurs:
aboutPage.offerItem1Text: unique, complex and conceptual fragrances from leading global brands for those seeking exclusivity and a distinctive trail.
aboutPage.offerItem2Text: refined, elegant masterpieces recognized worldwide from legendary fashion houses that remain timeless.
aboutPage.offerItem3Text: original perfumes in volumes from 2 to 10 ml (and more). An ideal way to wear an expensive fragrance on skin before buying a full bottle or to build an entire collection of rare perfumes at an accessible price.
aboutPage.offerItem4Text: ready-made fragrance sets for special occasions, cozy evenings, business meetings or hot summer days, curated by our experts.
aboutPage.whyItem1Text: We value our reputation and your trust. All perfumes are purchased exclusively from verified, official sources. Decanting is done with professional tools and strict adherence to technology that preserves every note and the longevity of the fragrance.
aboutPage.whyItem2Text: We pay special attention to detail and the concept of understated luxury. Each decant is presented in stylish, minimalist glass atomizers with quality fine mist spray. Our bottles are pleasant to hold, aesthetically fit into your space and easy to take with you.
aboutPage.whyItem3Text: The world of perfumery can seem complex, but we are here to be your guides. Our consultants will help you understand fragrance pyramids, explain the difference between notes and select the perfume that will unfold perfectly on your skin.
aboutPage.cultureText: We strive not only to sell fragrances, but to develop perfume culture. On our platform we share secrets of proper application and storage, tell the stories behind iconic scents, teach you to distinguish accords and help you develop your personal perfumery taste.
aboutPage.closingTitle: Find your perfect trail with Perfect Parfums!
aboutPage.closingText: Choose perfect.parfums — a place where every millilitre of perfumery excellence brings inspiration and confidence. Experiment with your look, discover new facets of brands and enjoy the highest quality of original perfumery. We are creating not just a store, but a true olfactory journey into a world of luxury and style.

cooperationPage.heroLead: We create more than footwear — a professional tool for self-expression. Join our partner network.
cooperationPage.cardWholesaleText: For retailers and dropshippers who value quality and up-to-date design. Flexible purchasing terms and full marketing support.
cooperationPage.cardInstructorsText: You shape dance culture — we equip you and your students with the best gear. Special terms for thought leaders.
cooperationPage.why1Desc: Timely delivery across Ukraine and international shipping with full order tracking.
cooperationPage.why2Desc: Original collections, inspection of every pair, and guaranteed adherence to stated standards.
cooperationPage.why3Desc: Dedicated support, marketing assets, and flexible terms for your business.
cooperationPage.why4Desc: We have already shipped orders to the USA, Canada, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and Poland — and this list keeps growing.

original.question: Is this original perfumery?
original.answer: Yes. We work with original fragrances in large bottles and decant them into convenient smaller volumes. You get the same composition without overpaying for brand packaging.

decant.question: How is decanting different from a store with full bottles?
decant.answer: You buy the volume you need, not an entire bottle. It is convenient for trying a scent, travel, or when you want several favorites at once.

longevity.question: How long-lasting are the scents?
longevity.answer: Longevity depends on the composition, concentration, and your skin. We will help you choose a fragrance that matches your expectations and advise how to apply it for a longer wear.

volumes.question: What volumes can I order?
volumes.answer: Convenient sizes are available from miniatures to larger bottles, depending on the fragrance and stock. Current options are always listed on the product page.

personalPick.question: Do you offer personal fragrance selection?
personalPick.answer: Yes. We started with curated picks on Instagram and still help you choose a scent for your style, mood, and season.

delivery.question: Do you deliver across Ukraine?
delivery.answer: Yes, we deliver orders across Ukraine. Details on methods, timing, and delivery cost are in the Payment & Delivery section.

aboutBrand.title: About Perfect Parfums
aboutBrand.leadSuffix: is a space where fragrance becomes part of your style.
aboutBrand.paragraph2: We started on Instagram with a curated selection tailored to your style, and we have kept that philosophy in everything we do. Here you will find premium perfumery: from light everyday classics to niche, oriental, and gourmand scents.
aboutBrand.paragraph3: We carefully select compositions so that every fragrance sounds pure and deep, and unfolds on your skin the way you deserve.
